_comment: Settlement transactions worth showing on the vault page, by chain. Only the hashes are stated here; every figure the dashboard displays about them — status, block, amounts, and the error a failed call reverted with — is read back off the chain by scripts/snapshot-chain.mjs and written to data/vault.<chainId>.json. Add a hash to have it appear; nothing else is needed.

transactions.label: Subscription against a published valuation
transactions.note: The oracle had struck a price, so the vault priced the subscription against it and minted.

transactions.label: Subscription against a refused valuation
transactions.note: The oracle had refused for this asset, so the same call reverted rather than transacting at a price nobody agreed on.
